author: Forbes
description:
What does it take to make your money work for you?

Your Rich BFF breaks down the philosophy behind her bestselling book, Rich AF, which has sold more than 250,000 copies.

From negotiating raises and budgeting to saving, investing and understanding debt, she explains the two sides of financial literacy: working hard for your money and making your money work for you.
title: Your Rich BFF: How to Make Your Money Work for You

author: Forbes
description:
Not every startup needs outside investors.

Your Rich BFF explains why she chose to self-fund Ask Dolly rather than take on outside investment. By bootstrapping her venture, she wanted the freedom to build a product on her own terms, prioritize quality and avoid investor pressure.
title: Your Rich BFF: Why She Bootstrapped Ask Dolly Instead of Taking on Investors

author: Forbes
description:
Student loan repayment is so confusing, even financial experts are struggling to keep up.

Your Rich BFF explains why student loan debt is one of the biggest concerns she hears from her audience. With repayment plans changing and borrowers struggling to understand their options, many are questioning whether their college degrees were worth the cost.

Watch the full episode of the Forbes Top Creators Podcast.
title: Your Rich BFF: Student Loan Repayment Is So Confusing

author: Forbes
description:
At 22, Vivian Tu couldn't afford a financial adviser. A decade later, Wall Street banks were reaching out to work with her.

The financial creator behind Your Rich BFF explains how her own experience and thousands of money-related DMs inspired her to launch Ask Dolly, a venture aimed at making financial guidance more accessible.
title: Your Rich BFF: Making Financial Advice More Accessible
